purpose: Evaluate calibrated evidence for one declared fault hypothesis against a no-fault null as independent, non-overlapping evidence blocks arrive, while preserving optional-stopping Type-I error control under the declared block-level null law.

model.likelihood_table: A fixed categorical outcome distribution under a simple null and one simple alternative, calibrated on the exact frozen block-aggregation protocol and one frozen channel.
model.statistic: log E_t = sum_j log(P_alt(B_j)/P_null(B_j)); one update per accepted block, never one update per raw sensor sample.
model.block_semantics: Each block has a unique evidence-unit ID, recording/channel identity, start/end times, block manifest digest and aggregation protocol digest. Blocks cannot overlap, must meet the preregistered minimum separation, and must be produced by the exact aggregation protocol covered by calibration.
model.dependence_review: A separately reviewed dependence receipt binds the assumed minimum separation and block construction. Its digest is content reference only; issuer identity, authority, signature, scope and revocation are verified upstream. The source code cannot prove physical or statistical independence.
model.decision: Cross the per-alternative threshold when E_t >= 1 / alpha_i; return model_conditional_evidence_threshold_crossed, never a physical-cause or operating-safety claim.
model.support: Every listed outcome has positive null probability. An observed outcome outside the frozen support poisons the session; zero-null-probability observations are never turned into infinite evidence.
model.replay: Each receipt binds the evidence-unit ID, block start/end and manifest digest, model, calibration, aggregation protocol, dependence-review receipt, input receipt, prior receipt, log e-value and threshold.

familywise_control.allocation: alpha_i = floor(familywise_alpha_ppm / alternative_count); sum_i alpha_i <= familywise_alpha_ppm.
familywise_control.dependence_between_alternatives: No independence assumption is required for the Bonferroni family-wise bound, but each individual null e-process must remain valid.

comparators.method: Evaluate one frozen calibrated block outcome per predeclared non-overlapping evidence unit.
Accumulate the same block-level simple-null/simple-alternative likelihood ratio using a fixed decision schedule.
The proposed process can be inspected after every accepted block and stopped at any data-dependent block count; validity follows from Ville's inequality under the block-level validity assumptions.
Deliberately invalid negative control that treats every highly correlated raw sensor sample as an independent e-process update; it must not be used for operational evidence.
Measure average expected posterior entropy reduction; this is evidence-acquisition utility, not a Type-I error guarantee.
Compare asymptotic pairwise mode separation under repeated block outcomes; this is not a finite-sample false-alarm guarantee.

validity_conditions.observations: The null and alternative block-outcome distributions must be valid for the declared block aggregation and dependence regime. Independent-block validity is an externally reviewed assumption, not inferred from non-overlap alone. The exact block protocol and separation are frozen before confirmatory testing.
validity_conditions.channel: One frozen channel, sensor semantics, operating regime, block aggregation protocol and likelihood table per session. Changing channel or block construction within a session is unsupported.
validity_conditions.model: The null and alternative likelihood distributions are fixed before confirmatory block outcomes; both are normalized and every supported block outcome has positive probability under each.
validity_conditions.calibration: Likelihoods are calibrated on disjoint independent episodes using the same block aggregation. A changed block length, overlap, minimum separation, sensor set or regime requires a new likelihood model and calibration.
validity_conditions.dependence: Every accepted block binds an independent-unit ID, block manifest, minimum temporal separation and dependence-review receipt. Repeated rows, overlapping windows and multiple outcomes from the same predeclared episode do not count as separate evidence units.
validity_conditions.optional_stopping: Under a valid nonnegative null e-process, Ville's inequality gives P(sup_t E_t >= 1/alpha_i) <= alpha_i, so users may inspect or stop at any accepted block without inflating the individual test's Type-I error.
validity_conditions.multiple_faults: Bonferroni allocation across the declared alternative count bounds the probability of any false fault alarm under the shared no-fault null by the family-wise alpha budget.

hard_gates: null and alternative IDs, channel, model digest, calibration digest, block aggregation digest, dependence review digest and outcome likelihood table are frozen before confirmatory testing
null and alternative block outcome probabilities each sum to one and every listed outcome has positive probability under each
each accepted update corresponds to exactly one unique block ID and a source-bound block manifest
raw 20 Hz rows and overlapping windows cannot be counted as separate independent evidence units
blocks cannot overlap and must meet the model's minimum temporal separation
calibration uses the same block aggregation protocol, channel, regime and minimum separation as confirmatory testing
one block outcome is appended in log space and replayed from the source-bound observation receipt
an unsupported outcome poisons the session rather than producing infinite evidence
the block-level null outcome law and independence/exchangeability assumptions are reviewed upstream and bound by a dependence-review receipt
the block stream is contiguous and the same model, likelihood table, dependence review and aggregation protocol are used for the entire session
Bonferroni per-alternative alpha is no greater than the allocated family-wise budget divided by the number of tested alternatives
optional-stopping claims are conditional on the block-level null e-process validity conditions; non-overlap alone is not proof of independence
a threshold crossing is a statistical flag for the declared model pair, not unique physical cause isolation or a maintenance/operating instruction
changed channel, controller mode, block aggregation, calibration, likelihood version or unsupported regime requires a new evidence session and model identity
receipt integrity is not signer authentication, trusted time or proof of physical sensor truth

research_targets_not_achieved.target: Across frozen no-fault replay episodes and predeclared block-level optional stopping rules, empirical family-wise false-alarm probability remains at or below the configured bound within independent-episode uncertainty.
Improve median and p95 fault-event detection latency versus a fixed-window block baseline at the same family-wise false-alarm budget, on matched independent episodes.
100% block receipt-chain and log-evidence replay on all accepted independent units, with zero raw-sample pseudo-replication.

Under a frozen synthetic repeated-sample dependence falsification suite, raw-sample pseudo-replication is always rejected and block-level evidence remains within the declared null false-alarm bound when the reviewed block model is valid.

evidence_boundaries.implementation: src/sequential_evidence.rs is source-authored; no real engine block likelihood model or dependence-review receipt has been calibrated or evaluated.
evidence_boundaries.validity: The optional-stopping guarantee is mathematical and model-conditional; non-overlap and synthetic unit tests do not validate real-world block independence or likelihood calibration.
evidence_boundaries.non_authority: A crossed threshold is not physical proof, unique isolation, maintenance authority, controller write permission or ODD clearance.
evidence_boundaries.cross_engine: A single engine test-bench cannot establish cross-engine or fleet validity.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic block-level likelihood mechanics and receipt replay only until block likelihoods are independently calibrated, dependence assumptions reviewed, independent null episodes audited, and event-level comparator runs completed.
